mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in FEDFUNDS above the 5-year monthly average precedes a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return by reducing real interest rate expectations.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above its 5-year monthly average
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically positive (p > 0.05) after the trigger, or FEDFUNDS reverts without sustained higher returns.

mechanism_narrative: Rising monthly PAYEMS accompanied by a decline in UNRATE predicts a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return as labor market strength offsets inflationary pressures.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases while UNRATE decreases over the next month
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.05 over 60-day horizon or UNRATE continues rising while PAYEMS stagnates.

mechanism_narrative: A consecutive monthly rise in HOUST above the prior two months' average indicates accelerating industrial demand, leading to positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative or HOUST does not show sustained acceleration over the next 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp expansion in INDPRO beyond its 12-month moving average suggests supply-side easing, which is associated with positive 5-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative or INDPRO contraction persists for >2 months.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS falls below 4% for three consecutive months, the S&P 20-day forward return is expected to turn negative due to higher real borrowing costs.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive despite sustained FEDFUNDS declines.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous peaks in PAYEMS and RSAFS with a sustained drop in UNRATE predict a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return via stronger employment and reduced wage growth expectations.
regime_hint: labor market peak with wage moderation
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.1 over 60-day window or employment/wage momentum reverses.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in CPIAUCSL below the 50th percentile of the past 12 months triggers a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return via expectations of future inflation pressure.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are positive or CPIAUCSL quickly rebounds above the 50th percentile.

mechanism_narrative: When INDPRO remains flat for two consecutive months amid a falling UNRATE, the S&P 500 shows a positive 5-day forward return as supply constraints ease with weaker wage growth.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO flat for 2 months and UNRATE decreasing
regime_hint: supply chain moderation with softer labor
failure_condition: 5-day returns negative or INDPRO continues contracting while UNRATE rises.
